note: Text Resize provides a block plugin text_resize_block (+A/-A/reset links) placed via Block Layout, plus one config object text_resize.settings (form route text_resize_settings at /admin/config/user-interface/text_resize, permission 'administer text_resize'): text_resize_scope (default 'main'), text_resize_minimum (12), text_resize_maximum (25), text_resize_reset_button (false), text_resize_line_height_allow (false), _min (16), _max (36). No dependencies beyond core Block, no Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real text_resize.settings config and in a live block placement of text_resize_block (cleanup removes any such placement). Shipped defaults are restored explicitly.

evals.prompt: I want to let visitors make the text on my Drupal site bigger or smaller with on-page buttons. Which module does this and what are the two steps to get it showing?
evals.expected_output: Text Resize. Place its 'Text Resize' block (plugin text_resize_block) in a region via Block Layout, and configure behavior (scope, min/max size, reset button) at /admin/config/user-interface/text_resize.

evals.prompt: In the Text Resize module, which config object and setting control which part of the page gets resized, and the minimum/maximum font size? What is the default scope?
evals.expected_output: Config object text_resize.settings: text_resize_scope is the CSS selector resized (default 'main'), text_resize_minimum (12px) and text_resize_maximum (25px) bound the size; also text_resize_reset_button and the line-height options.

evals.prompt: Which permission controls access to the Text Resize settings form?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer text_resize' permission gates the settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/text_resize (route text_resize_settings).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Text Resize module's scope has been customized. Inspect the live configuration and state which CSS selector/scope the text resizing is applied to.
evals.expected_output: text_resize_scope is 'main-content' in text_resize.settings (read via `drush config:get text_resize.settings text_resize_scope`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Text Resize module has a customized maximum font size. Inspect the live configuration and state the maximum font size (in pixels) that users can resize text to.
On this Drupal site, configure the Text Resize module so that the block includes a reset button (letting users return text to the default size). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: text_resize.settings text_resize_reset_button is TRUE (e.g. `drush config:set text_resize.settings text_resize_reset_button true -y`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, place the Text Resize block into a region of the default theme so visitors can resize text. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A block config entity with plugin text_resize_block is placed in a region and enabled (create a Block entity with plugin 'text_resize_block' or use Block Layout).
